method: Read all 99 es values side by side with en and en.context.json, judging accuracy, idiom, register and glossary consistency per the es style guide (tú address, infinitive action labels, neutral Spanish).

Parsed every message with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser and compared argument, tag, select, plural-category and number-skeleton structure with English: 98 messages are structurally identical; ui.chat.composer.secret_confirm_chars adds the required es many arm (one/many/other) and no other difference exists.

Rendered the plural through IntlMessageFormat locale es at 1, 2, 1000, 1234, 1000000, 1500000 and 2000000: 1 carácter / 2 caracteres / 1.000.000 de caracteres (many) / 1.500.000 caracteres (other), and viewer.image_progress renders Imagen 1 de 1234.
Checked utf-8 hygiene across all 99 values: NFC, no manual bidi controls, no NBSP/NNBSP/ZWSP/BOM/SHY, no leading/trailing whitespace, no duplicate keys, no value identical to its English source.

Scanned the three namespaces for glossary/register drift: tú throughout (no usted/vosotros), infinitive action labels, endpoint kept English per glossary §2, Canvas kept untranslated, proveedor / [redacted] / panel de consultas / consulta al margen used consistently, Intro and Mayús+Tab used consistently inside the chat surfaces.
Compared expansion ratios against the sidecar maxCells advisory and the English source; strings over 30% growth without a budget are recorded under overflow_observations, not as defects.
